The two ways to order

Tap through the menus

Send "hi". You get buttons: Buy Data, Track Order, Help. Pick a network, pick a size, enter the number, confirm, pay with MoMo.

Type a quick order

One message, straight to confirmation: 2gb mtn 0241234567. Size, network and number in any order.

Track by chat

Send track VD-260813-1234 with your order reference and get the current status without opening the site.

Pay the same way

Checkout is the identical Valmont-Pay pipeline — MoMo prompt on your phone, approved with your PIN.

The bot understands the names people actually use: vodafone or voda for Telecel, tigo, airtel or at for AirtelTigo, and sizes typed as gb, gigs, mb or megs. If you ask for a size we do not stock, it lists the sizes that network does have.

Payment, delivery and refunds

Payment goes through Valmont-Pay — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money or card. We never see or store your MoMo PIN: you approve every charge on your own phone.

Delivery starts the moment payment confirms. Most bundles arrive within minutes; it depends on the network at the time. Every order gets a tracking reference and an SMS confirmation.

If a delivery fails we retry it automatically (up to three attempts) and refund it automatically if it still won't complete. Wrong numbers are not refundable — check the line before you pay.

You can buy for any number — yours, a family member's or a customer's. You do not have to be the account holder, and the site warns you if the prefix you typed belongs to a different network.

If a chat order goes wrong, the same reference works on the Track Order page, and our support team answers on the same WhatsApp number around the clock.

Questions people ask before buying

What is the WhatsApp number for buying data?

+233 54 245 1578 — open the chat and send "hi". It is the same number our support team answers.

How do I make a quick order in one message?

Type the size, the network and the number, for example 2gb mtn 0241234567. The bot confirms the bundle and price and asks you to approve the MoMo payment.

Can I pay with MoMo on WhatsApp?

Payment goes through Valmont-Pay — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money or card. We never see or store your MoMo PIN: you approve every charge on your own phone.

Can I check an order on WhatsApp?

Yes — send track followed by your reference (it looks like VD-260813-1234). The Track Order page does the same thing in a browser.

What if I type a size you do not have?

The bot tells you and lists the sizes that network actually stocks, so you can pick a real one instead of guessing.

Is the WhatsApp price the same as the website price?

Yes — both come from the same catalogue. The price list above is the one the bot sells from.
